messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide you can use whether you’re selling locally or online: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1️⃣ Inspect & Clean** | Give your guitar a thorough check—look for cracks, loose hardware, worn strings, and overall wear. A clean body/neck makes it look more appealing. | Buyers notice details; a well‑maintained instrument fetches higher prices. | | **2️⃣ Gather Documentation** | Find original paperwork, receipts, manuals, or proof of authenticity (especially important for vintage or high‑end models). | Adds credibility and may increase resale value. | | **3️⃣ Determine Condition Rating** | Classify as “Excellent,” “Good,” “Fair,” or “Needs Repair.” Be honest—you’ll avoid disputes later. | Sets buyer expectations and protects you from claims after sale. | | **4️⃣ Research Comparable Prices** | Search recent sales on eBay, Reverb, local classifieds, or specialty forums. Take note of similar brands/models, age, and condition. | Helps set a realistic asking price and gives you leverage during negotiations. | | **5️⃣ Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • Local: Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Nextdoor
• Online marketplaces: eBay, Reverb, Etsy (for vintage)
• Specialty groups/forums: Gearslutz, Guitar Center Classifieds | Different platforms reach different audiences; using multiple increases exposure. | | **6️⃣ Capture High‑Quality Photos** | Use natural light, shoot close‑ups of headstock, fretboard, bridge, electronics, and any flaws. Include a photo of the serial number. | Visual evidence builds trust and reduces return rates. | | **7️⃣ Write an Honest Description** | Mention make/model, year, finish, action, tuning stability, pickups/electronics (if applicable), and any modifications. State its current condition rating. | Transparency attracts serious buyers and speeds up the process. | | **8️⃣ Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above what you’d accept so there’s room to negotiate. If you’re flexible, consider offering bundle deals (strings, case, strap) to sweeten the offer. | Gives you negotiating power while still attracting interest. | | **9️⃣ Decide Payment Method** | For local sales: cash or Venmo/EFT transfer.
For online: PayPal Goods & Services, Escrow.com, or direct bank transfers. | Protects both parties against fraud. | | 🔟 Arrange Safe Meeting / Shipping | • Meet in daylight at a public place (coffee shop, library parking lot).
• If shipping, pack securely with foam inserts, double box, and insurance. Label clearly with tracking info. | Safety first! And proper packaging prevents damage en route. | ### Quick Tips * **Timing:** Listings posted mid‑week often get more views than weekend posts because people browse during work hours. * **Negotiation Pointers:** Keep your bottom line clear but stay open to reasonable offers. Respond promptly—it shows professionalism. * **Safety Checklist for In‑Person Sales:** * Bring a friend or family member if possible. * Meet in a busy area or store lobby where staff can see you. * Verify payment before handing over the instrument. * **Shipping Checklist:** * Use a sturdy cardboard crate or padded hardcase. * Add bubble wrap around the neck and body separately. * Seal all seams with packing tape and label “Fragile” prominently. --- #### Want More Help? Feel free to tell me: * Where you live (city/state) * How old/good your guitar is * Brand/model specifics I can then tailor pricing suggestions or recommend specific local listings that have worked best in your region.
message.reasoning:
The user asks "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We need to provide guidance. No tool needed.

We respond with helpful steps: evaluate condition, price research, choose platform (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace), take good photos, write description, list, negotiate, meet safely, etc. Also mention shipping options if online. Provide safety tips. Possibly ask follow-up questions about location, condition, brand. But we just give general answer.
